changelog:
Major Update - 20/08/2026

• Reworked Home for v1.3 with UI News and persistent read tracking
• Added personalized time based greetings with a saved Home username
• Added the Zenith 1.3 theme and made it the default
• Renamed the old V5 theme to Pink
• Changed theme switching to a smooth crossfade so it no longer stutters or reloads the page
• Changed Inject to Attach across the UI and made Attach work everywhere
• Added Roblox client selector in the navigation panel, you can control each client by PID or account and execute on one attached account
• Added an option to hide the Roblox client selector
• Added Attach Status modes so it can show dot and text, text only, dot only or nothing
• Added an adjustable Auto Attach delay and an option to hide Attach when Auto Attach is enabled
• Added SirHurt and Roblox version checks before attaching and a warning if they dont match
• Added an Attached line in the console when attaching finishes
• Added a Roblox CPU limit so you can cap how many cores each Roblox client uses
• Fixed Attach and Auto Attach not working again after opening another Roblox instance
• Fixed attaching failing when a SirHurt verification file is missing by using a local backup
• Added built in SirHurt MCP with easy install and uninstall for Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity
• Changed MCP and Lua Console Relay to use separate hidden Auto Execute scripts that dont show in Auto Execute settings
• Added a popup to put the MCP or Lua Console Relay script back if it is missing
• Added a 3 second delay before MCP starts in Roblox
• Fixed the MCP app logos so they are all white and match each other
• Added an option to redirect the Roblox console into the SirHurt Lua Console
• Added live file editing for tabs linked to .lua, .luau and .txt files
• Added resizable Files and SirHurt Output windows to Editor with snapping to their original sizes
• Made Files and SirHurt Output open expanded by default
• Added Create Multiple when right clicking the New Tab button with a limit of 50 at once
• Added detailed Editor Button settings for text, icons, size, spacing, shape, layout, glow and visibility
• Added an option to show Lua Output instead of SirHurt Output under the editor
• Improved Lua and Luau suggestions, snippets and SirHurt functions in the editor
• Fixed New Tab not creating a tab and improved closed tab History
• Fixed empty tabs and tabs opened from History being added into History again
• Fixed the Match Brackets setting never reaching the editor
• Added official SirHurt Documentation inside the UI with 14 libraries, 133 functions and 18 types
• Added categories, search, copy buttons and the official source to Documentation
• Made Documentation open on General by default
• Fully reworked Keybinds and added custom keybinds for almost every action
• Added global keybinds that keep working while SirHurt is unfocused
• Added a confirmation before resetting all keybinds
• Fully reworked Account Manager navigation, settings, servers, history and statistics to match the rest of the UI
• Improved Account Manager support for Sirstrap, WEAO Web Launcher and other launchers
• Added a separate Roblox login window when adding an account
• Fixed Account Manager not loading because of missing portable data and added proper loading, retry and error screens
• Fixed Account Manager account moving and made the reorder animation smooth
• Changed Account Manager notifications and icons to follow the selected theme color
• Added HaxHell and RobloxScripts as Script Hub sources so you can search four sites
• Fixed the Script Hub copy link always copying an RScripts link no matter the source
• Reorganized Interface, Editor, Execution and the other Settings pages into better groups
• Added detailed Gradient Settings with extra glow, style, strength, bar animation, homepage only, speed and strength options
• Added navigation panel density, icon size and active page indicator options
• Added corner radius, settings density and group surface style options
• Added motion speed, options reveal style and overlay scrollbar style options
• Added a button glow intensity option for the editor buttons
• Added drag to reorder for the pages in the side navigation panel
• Moved the side navigation page list onto its own page
• Added NEW labels next to all new settings
• Moved Information & Help into a popup inside Settings
• Rebuilt the color picker into a proper color mixer with a saturation and brightness area, hue slider and hex and RGB inputs
• Changed the default settings so a fresh install starts on the recommended setup
• Fixed Reset Settings not clearing everything it owns including keybinds
• Fixed Settings not returning to where you were scrolled when using the back arrow
• Fixed Settings search showing empty group titles when nothing matched
• Fixed the navigation panel slideout animation not playing
• Removed UI Size, the window can now be resized freely from any edge or corner
• Fixed the window getting bigger every time it was minimized or maximized and then restored
• Added RakNet Library
• Added options to run the bootstrapper when the UI opens or when SirHurt files are missing
• Reworked notifications so they are transparent, glossy, use the selected theme color and stack in the bottom right
• Changed menus, context menus, notifications and docks to be transparent and blurred
• Added blue and pink corner glows to Documentation and new corner glows to Utilities, Account Manager and Join Server
• Reworked Editor, Script Hub, Utilities, Account Manager and Documentation spacing and scrollbars to match Home
• Replaced the old scrollbars across the UI and inside every popup with the new overlay scrollbar and removed the clickable top and bottom arrows
• Fixed the SirHurt and Lua consoles not being the same size
• Changed the Home, Console and Documentation icons
• Fixed broken close icons and other weird symbols in the UI
• Fixed the Roblox Cleaner button not being clickable and the Continue button not working after the countdown
• Rebuilt the tutorial for the new layout with steps for the reworked Account Manager, Documentation and Utilities
• Added a clean v1.2 to v1.3 update that keeps Scripts, Auto Execute, Workspace, settings, tabs, History and Account Manager data
• Added cleanup of old 1.2 application files before the new UI starts
• Fixed the loader setting, window position and window size never being saved
• Fixed the SirHurt update popup being closable by clicking outside it
• Changed searches and text boxes so pressing Enter stops typing
• Reorganized the frontend and backend into modules so everything is easier to work on
• Enabled F12 Developer Tools
• Fixed many other bugs and made lots of UI, visual and quality improvements
